environment_details.style_notes: High-fidelity 3D; the sand pit is a perfect inverted cone; the larva is mostly hidden, only its large, curved mandibles are visible at the very bottom.

visual_logic.composition: A high-angle 'look-down' shot into a cluster of three antlion pits. The pits are located in the soft, dry sand beneath a sandstone overhang. One pit is currently active, with tiny puffs of sand being 'flicked' out by the hidden larva to maintain the steepness of the walls.
visual_logic.ground: Fine, powdery red sand with high-detail surface displacement to show the 'slump' lines of the cone.
visual_logic.lighting: Strong directional light creating a deep, crescent-shaped shadow inside each cone, emphasizing the depth and danger of the trap.
